Marta: Quick heads up — hotpatch v0.9.3 (PR #9842) is in the merge queue. Cutoff at 11:15 PT. We need 2 approvers. I have one LGTM but still need a second. Can someone be standby approver? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ashok: I can be standby. Pulling it now, will skim for the KV-cache regression I fixed earlier.
Sam: I can give a rapid pass if nothing major, in a call until 11:00 but can approve by 11:05 if it's small.
Marta: Thanks — tagging @Ashok then. If Ashok flags anything high-risk, we should hold. If it's just nits, Sam, feel free to approve after your call.
Ashok: Quick note — I see one integration test flake in CI job `integration/kv-cache` but logs look unrelated to this patch. Posting snippet:```
FAIL: tests/test_kv_warmup.py::test_warmup_timeout
AssertionError: expected <= 0.5s but got 0.62s
```
Jen: @Marta @Ashok if that test is flaky and not introduced by this change, I'm fine with approving and adding a follow-up ticket to stabilize.
Sam: If Jen's good and Ashok doesn't block, I can approve at 11:05. Otherwise we escalate to oncall for quick triage.
Marta: Agreed. @release-bot what's current merge queue position?
release-bot: PR #9842 is at position 2 in the merge queue. Current merge window: 11:15 PT cutoff. Estimated deploy risk: low. :robot_face:
Ashok: No behavioral changes besides a timeout tweak I made earlier. I'm not seeing any smoke failures locally. Approving unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
Marta: Thanks. Sam — still good to approve by 11:05?
Sam: Yep will do. Leaving my call early. :eyes:
Sam: Approved and added comment: "Quick pass — tests flaky but infra looks unrelated, ok to merge before cutoff."
Marta: Two approvals received. Proceeding to merge at ~11:07 unless someone yells hold.
Jen: Not going to block. Filing follow-up ticket for flaky test.
Marta: Merged. Notifying release channel and will watch post-cutover metrics for 15m. :rocket:
release-bot: Merge confirmed for PR #9842 by Marta at 11:07 PT. Post-deploy alert window 15m.
Marta: Thanks all — special thanks to Ashok & Sam for quick standby approvals. If any anomalies, ping #incidents and @oncall.
